Perfect service, fresh Vietnamese cuisine, excellent wines, and stylish ambiance. A wonderful experience.
Sep 2026 • Couples
★★★★★

An all-around wonderful dining experience! The service was perfect from start to finish.

Naturally, we opted for Vietnamese cuisine and were delighted: wonderfully aromatic, fresh, and prepared with great attention to detail. The wine selection is also excellent, offering a very appealing variety that perfectly complements the food.

The experience is rounded off by a stylish and tasteful ambiance where you immediately feel at ease. Everything is simply perfect here—from the service and cuisine to the atmosphere.

A clear recommendation and definitely a restaurant we will be happy to visit again!
